body:
CHIEF RULING — WeightedCoverage APPROVED AS PROPOSED. Take it. Four things it does that I did not
ask for, and one that changes my own ruling.

    final class WeightedCoverage private (
      val estimate: ScoreEstimate, val conditioningWeight: Double, val coverage: Coverage)

1. IT FINDS A CONFLATION INSIDE THE THING I RULED ON. `wsum <= 0` currently labels OBSERVED
ALL-ZERO WEIGHTS as `AllMissing`. "No leaf carried an importance" and "leaves carried importance
and all of it was zero" are different states, and the code calls both the same. I read that branch
this hour, ruled on the field, and did not see it. Your three-way split -- zero observed ->
Missing(AllMissing); observed but zero total weight -> Missing(Undefined(ZeroTotalWeight));
positive -> Observed -- is a strictly better answer than the two-way one I was correcting toward.

2. IT TURNS MY ARGUMENT INTO A TEST. I justified two carriers with a hypothetical: a large wsum
from a few heavy leaves and an identical wsum from many light ones are different situations with
the same normalizer. You made that the REQUIRED DISCRIMINATOR through RecallSignature.compute --
same eligible leaves, same wsum, same numeric value, one heavy observed leaf versus two light ones,
and only coverage may differ. An argument that becomes a failing test when the design is wrong is
worth more than the argument.

3. `conditioningWeight` RENDERS SEPARATELY AND IS NEVER DIVIDED BY THE ELIGIBLE COUNT. That single
constraint is the whole mass-versus-count discipline made structural, and it is the exact error I
made an hour ago recommending MassRatio. Keep that sentence in the source, not just the proposal.

4. PRIVATE-CONSTRUCTOR NON-CASE CLASS WITH CHECKED CONSTRUCTION, so the four-way relation cannot be
forged. That is AGENTS.md rule 8's forward obligation -- a new public type whose fields stand in a
derived proof relation must be BORN unforgeable -- applied without being told. Copy slice A's probe
shape; it is on main at 2ddbcd5 and carries the best control we have.

ON THE ADR QUESTION, since you flagged this as a public vocabulary addition: RECORD IT AS AN
AMENDMENT TO ADR 0003, NOT A NEW ADR. It implements 0003's contract -- a published figure carries
its support -- rather than deciding new policy. A new ADR would imply the decision is novel; it is
0003 finally being given a carrier for the case where support is a count and conditioning is a
mass.

SCOPE: this is one of the five shapes, not the backlog. `uniform`, the external terms with their
subnormalization trap, `distortedByFacet` and `perUnitLocalizability` are still separate and must
not be done by copying this either -- which is the mistake I made offering the whole backlog as
"same shape as specificity".

Mint the child bead yourself under bd-01M16E05TWX28QKJF2GFY67ZZV. It moves a published figure, so
per your own argument it wants uninterrupted ownership -- do not start it in a window you do not
have. Ruling recorded on the parent bead as well as here.
